papers.title: From "Tech Fear" to Digital Self-Efficacy: A COM-B and TDF Analysis of Tele-Exercise Engagement in Older Adults at Risk of Falls
papers.translated_title: 从“技术恐惧”到数字自我效能：基于COM-B模型与TDF框架对跌倒风险老年人远程运动参与的分析
papers.author: CHAN, K. O.-w.
papers.summary: Background: Tele exercise offers an alternative approach to physical activity for older adults, however remote delivery introduces distinctive challenges. Objectives: Nested within a 3 month randomised controlled trial (RCT), this qualitative study explored the experiences of community dwelling older adults at risk of falls who completed synchronous tele exercise, mapping findings to the COM B model, Theoretical Domains Framework (TDF), and Behaviour Change Techniques (BCTs) to inform intervention design. Methods: Semi structured interviews and delivery format preference queries were conducted with 25 purposively sampled older adults following the intervention. Data were analysed using hybrid thematic analysis integrated with COM B, TDF, and the Behaviour Change Wheel (BCW). Results: Despite baseline digital literacy barriers, participants engaged successfully across six themes: Technological Skills, Access & Support; Coach Support & Exercise Adaptability; Health Motivation & Goal Achievement; Emotional Journey with Technology; Home Environment & Accessibility; and Social Interaction Dynamics. Core BCTs addressing low digital literacy and physical limitations included practical social support (in-home onboarding), environmental restructuring (hardware setup), graded tasks, and social reward. These techniques facilitated an emotional transition from initial apprehension to pride, fostering digital self-efficacy. Notably, an implementation paradox emerged: while over half preferred face-to-face (f2f) delivery, they demonstrated high adherence in tele -exercise programme, indicating that delivery preference does not preclude digital capability. Conclusion: Tele-exercise is feasible and acceptable for older adults at risk of falls, challenging assumptions that low digital literacy precludes digital health adoption. Embedding targeted BCTs within a scaffolded framework addresses structural and psychological barriers, reinforcing digital self-efficacy to sustain remote participation.
papers.translated_summary: 背景：远程运动为老年人提供了一种替代性的身体活动方式，但远程交付带来了独特的挑战。目的：本定性研究嵌套在一项为期3个月的随机对照试验（RCT）中，探讨了有跌倒风险的社区居住老年人在完成同步远程运动后的体验，并将研究结果映射到COM-B模型、理论域框架（TDF）和行为改变技术（BCTs），以指导干预设计。方法：在干预结束后，对25名目的性抽样的老年人进行了半结构化访谈和交付形式偏好询问。数据采用混合主题分析，并结合COM-B、TDF和行为改变轮（BCW）进行分析。结果：尽管存在基线数字素养障碍，参与者仍成功参与，并呈现出六大主题：技术技能、获取与支持；教练支持与运动适应性；健康动机与目标达成；伴随技术的情感历程；家庭环境与可及性；以及社交互动动态。针对低数字素养和身体限制的核心BCTs包括实际社会支持（居家入门指导）、环境重构（硬件设置）、分级任务和社会奖励。这些技术促进了参与者从最初的不安到自豪的情感转变，培养了数字自我效能感。值得注意的是，出现了一个实施悖论：尽管超过半数参与者偏好面对面（f2f）交付，但他们在远程运动项目中表现出高依从性，这表明交付偏好并不排除数字能力。结论：远程运动对有跌倒风险的老年人是可行且可接受的，挑战了低数字素养会阻碍数字健康采用的假设。在支架式框架中嵌入有针对性的BCTs可解决结构和心理障碍，增强数字自我效能感以维持远程参与。

papers.title: An Interactive Trustworthy AI Pathology Copilot to Improve Biomarker-Driven Prognostic Stratification and Therapeutic Response Prediction
papers.translated_title: 一个交互式可信AI病理助手，用于改进生物标志物驱动的预后分层和治疗反应预测
papers.author: Mao, Y.
papers.summary: Predictive assays for precision oncology increasingly rely on multi-scale biomarkers that manifest as morphological signatures in routine whole-slide images (WSIs). However, most computational pathology models treat biomarker profiling and outcome prediction (i.e., prognostic stratification and therapeutic response) as independent tasks, and lack the interactive and trustworthy capabilities required for clinical translation. Here, we present TEAM, an interactive trustworthy AI pathology copilot that improves biomarker-driven outcome prediction. Pretrained on 55,648 pan-cancer WSIs and 1,750,648 regions of interest (ROIs), comprising 360 million patches, TEAM learns risk-aware embeddings by conditioning on clinical metadata and aligning with the relative risk prior. Patch-level data (aleatoric) and model (epistemic) uncertainty are quantified for trustworthy assessment and then propagated to slide-level predictions. In outcome prediction, TEAM uses profiled biomarkers as intermediate features to contextualize prognostic and therapeutic estimates. Beyond passive prediction, we integrate vision-language models with agentic orchestration for clinical reasoning, and provide a web-based clinician-in-the-loop interface for interactive prediction refinement. TEAM outperforms existing methods on 88 benchmarks spanning 51 multi-institutional cohorts across biomarker profiling, prognostic stratification, and therapeutic response prediction, supporting trustworthy AI-assisted decision-making in computational pathology.
papers.translated_summary: 精准肿瘤学的预测性检测日益依赖于多尺度生物标志物，这些标志物在常规全切片图像（WSIs）中表现为形态学特征。然而，大多数计算病理学模型将生物标志物分析与结局预测（即预后分层和治疗反应）视为独立任务，缺乏临床转化所需的交互性和可信性能力。在此，我们提出TEAM，一种交互式可信AI病理辅助系统，用于改进生物标志物驱动的结局预测。TEAM在55,648张泛癌WSIs和1,750,648个感兴趣区域（ROIs）上进行预训练，涵盖3.6亿个图像块，通过以临床元数据为条件并与相对风险先验对齐，学习风险感知嵌入。图像块级数据（偶然）不确定性和模型（认知）不确定性被量化以实现可信评估，随后传播至切片级预测。在结局预测中，TEAM利用分析的生物标志物作为中间特征，为预后和治疗估计提供上下文。除被动预测外，我们将视觉-语言模型与智能体编排相结合用于临床推理，并提供基于网络的临床医生在环界面以实现交互式预测优化。TEAM在涵盖51个多机构队列的88项基准上，在生物标志物分析、预后分层和治疗反应预测方面优于现有方法，支持计算病理学中可信的AI辅助决策。

papers.title: External Validation of a Brain Imaging Model for Predicting Psychosis in Clinical High-Risk Cohorts
papers.translated_title: 脑影像模型在临床高风险队列中预测精神病的外部验证
papers.author: Vetter, C. S.
papers.summary: Importance: Structural magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) models for predicting psychosis in people at clinical high risk (CHR-P) are rarely tested in new cohorts, so whether and why they lose accuracy is unknown. Objective: To test whether a structural MRI model predicts psychosis in external cohorts and adds to symptom ratings, whether its accuracy varies with participant characteristics, and what explains differences between cohorts. Design: This prognostic study applied the PRONIA structural MRI model, re-estimated in its training sample (329 participants; 26 transitions), without refitting to 4 external cohorts. Data were analyzed from July 2025 to October 2026. Setting: Early-recognition services in North America and Europe. Participants People at CHR-P in 4 external cohorts. Exposure Baseline MRI risk score. Main Outcomes and Measures: Transition to psychosis by study-specific criteria (symptom duration, 1 week to 1 month); discrimination (area under the curve [AUC]), calibration, net benefit, added value beyond symptoms, and discrimination by participant characteristics, site, and outcome group. Results: Among 685 external participants (mean [SD] age, 20.0 [5.1] years; 319 [46.6%] female; 106 transitions), the AUC was 0.53 in NAPLS-3, 0.56 in MUC-FRUE, 0.65 in ZInEP, and 0.69 in FePsy (pooled, 0.56; 95% CI, 0.51-0.62), compared with 0.74 in PRONIA. The calibration slope was 0.17 (95% CI, 0.01-0.34), no probabilities gave clear net benefit, and adding the MRI score to symptom ratings changed AUC by 0.01 (95% CI, -0.02 to 0.05). Only negative symptoms hinted at better discrimination, and not robustly (q = .15). Participants without transition scored like those in PRONIA, whereas those with transition scored lower, so sensitivity fell from 0.92 to 0.57 with similar specificity (0.52 vs 0.55). Within-site comparisons, reweighting for age, sex, and symptoms, and alternative classifiers did not restore discrimination. Conclusions and Relevance: Outside its training cohort, this MRI model predicted psychosis poorly, a loss confined to people who developed psychosis and unexplained by scanners or participant characteristics. People may reach psychosis by routes that differ between cohorts, only some of them visible in brain structure. Identifying those for whom an MRI risk score works, if any, requires far more transitions, counted by shared criteria.
papers.translated_summary: 重要性：用于预测临床高危精神病（CHR-P）人群发病的结构磁共振成像（MRI）模型很少在新队列中验证，因此其是否以及为何失去准确性尚不清楚。目的：检验结构MRI模型能否在外部队列中预测精神病，并是否在症状评估之外提供增量价值，其准确性是否随参与者特征变化，以及队列间差异的原因。设计：本预后研究应用PRONIA结构MRI模型，在其训练样本（329名参与者；26例转化）中重新估计，未对4个外部队列进行重新拟合。数据分析时间为2025年7月至2026年10月。环境：北美和欧洲的早期识别服务机构。参与者：4个外部队列中的CHR-P人群。暴露：基线MRI风险评分。主要结局与指标：按研究特定标准（症状持续时间1周至1个月）转化为精神病；区分度（曲线下面积[AUC]）、校准、净获益、症状之外的增量价值，以及按参与者特征、站点和结局组划分的区分度。结果：在685名外部参与者中（平均[SD]年龄20.0[5.1]岁；319名[46.6%]女性；106例转化），AUC在NAPLS-3中为0.53，在MUC-FRUE中为0.56，在ZInEP中为0.65，在FePsy中为0.69（合并0.56；95% CI，0.51-0.62），而PRONIA中为0.74。校准斜率为0.17（95% CI，0.01-0.34），没有任何概率给出明确的净获益，将MRI评分加入症状评估使AUC变化0.01（95% CI，-0.02至0.05）。仅阴性症状提示区分度较好，且不稳健（q = .15）。未转化者的评分与PRONIA中相似，而转化者评分较低，因此敏感性从0.92降至0.57，特异性相似（0.52 vs 0.55）。站点内比较、按年龄、性别和症状重新加权以及替代分类器均未能恢复区分度。结论与意义：在其训练队列之外，该MRI模型对精神病的预测效果较差，这种损失仅限于发生精神病的人群，且无法由扫描仪或参与者特征解释。人群可能通过队列间不同的途径达到精神病，其中仅部分途径在脑结构中可见。识别MRI风险评分对哪些人有效（如果有的话），需要更多按共享标准计数的转化病例。

papers.title: Efficacy of Personalized Connectivity-Guided Accelerated Brain Stimulation in a Naturalistic Treatment-Resistant Depression Population
papers.translated_title: 个体化连接引导加速脑刺激在自然主义治疗抵抗性抑郁人群中的疗效
papers.author: Kong, R.
papers.summary: Personalized connectivity-guided accelerated intermittent theta burst stimulation (iTBS) has shown promising efficacy for treatment-resistant depression (TRD) in carefully selected trial populations. Evidence remains limited in naturalistic TRD patients with complex psychiatric comorbidities often excluded from such trials. Here, we report an open-label, single-arm proof-of-concept study of a personalized connectivity-guided targeting approach, TAO-TMS (Tree-based Algorithm for Optimized Transcranial Magnetic Stimulation), in a naturalistic Asian TRD sample. Participants averaged 1.7 psychiatric comorbidities, including personality disorders, autism and obsessive-compulsive disorder. Of 21 enrolled participants, 20 completed 50 iTBS sessions over 5 days. The primary outcome was response rate ([≥]50% reduction in Montgomery-Asberg Depression Rating Scale score) immediately after treatment. Among participants with available data, response rates were 65% immediately after treatment, 50% at 1 month and 31% at 3 months. In exploratory analyses, 70% responded within 4 weeks post-treatment; the corresponding rate was 83% in a subgroup of participants meeting typical randomized-trial eligibility criteria (N = 12). For descriptive local context, we note that a retrospective cohort at the same hospital receiving non-accelerated TMS with scalp-based BeamF3 targeting had an immediate response rate of 22%. Post hoc electric-field modeling confirmed that TAO-TMS achieved the intended targeting of attention networks. Statistically significant functional connectivity changes were observed in each participant, but varied widely across participants. Exploratory economic modeling suggested lower one-year costs for TAO-TMS than electroconvulsive therapy, with similar quality-adjusted life-years. TAO-TMS was feasible and well tolerated. Its preliminary clinical signal warrants evaluation in randomized controlled trials.
papers.translated_summary: 个性化连接引导的加速间歇性θ爆发刺激（iTBS）在精心筛选的试验人群中已显示出对难治性抑郁症（TRD）的良好疗效。在常被此类试验排除、伴有复杂精神共病的自然主义TRD患者中，证据仍然有限。在此，我们报告一项开放标签、单臂的概念验证研究，评估个性化连接引导的靶向方法TAO-TMS（基于树的优化经颅磁刺激算法）在自然主义亚洲TRD样本中的应用。参与者平均有1.7种精神共病，包括人格障碍、自闭症和强迫症。21名入组参与者中，20名在5天内完成了50次iTBS治疗。主要结局为治疗结束后即刻的应答率（Montgomery-Asberg抑郁评定量表评分降低≥50%）。在有可用数据的参与者中，治疗结束后即刻应答率为65%，1个月时为50%，3个月时为31%。在探索性分析中，70%在治疗结束后4周内应答；在符合典型随机试验入选标准的参与者亚组（N = 12）中，相应应答率为83%。作为描述性本地背景，我们注意到同一医院一个接受基于头皮BeamF3靶向的非加速TMS的回顾性队列，其即刻应答率为22%。事后电场建模证实TAO-TMS实现了对注意网络的预期靶向。每名参与者均观察到统计学显著的功能连接变化，但参与者之间差异很大。探索性经济建模提示，TAO-TMS的一年成本低于电休克治疗，且质量调整生命年相似。TAO-TMS可行且耐受良好。其初步临床信号值得在随机对照试验中评估。

papers.title: SHARED GENETIC ARCHITECTURE AND DIRECTIONAL ASSOCIATIONS BETWEEN ATTENTION-DEFICIT/HYPERACTIVITY AND BORDERLINE PERSONALITY DISORDERS: AN INTEGRATIVE GENOMIC ANALYSIS
papers.translated_title: 注意缺陷/多动障碍与边缘型人格障碍之间的共享遗传结构及方向性关联：一项整合基因组分析
papers.author: Gorgone, G.
papers.summary: Background: attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder (ADHD) and borderline personality disorder (BPD) frequently co-occur, but their shared genetic susceptibility and directional associations remain unclear. Methods: we analyzed European-ancestry genome-wide association study (GWAS) data for ADHD (38,691 cases; 186,843 controls) and BPD (12,339 cases; 1,041,717 controls). Linkage disequilibrium score regression, conjunctional false discovery rate (conjFDR), bidirectional Mendelian randomization (MR), MR accounting for linkage disequilibrium and sample overlap (MR-LAP), Causal Analysis Using Summary Effect estimates (CAUSE), colocalization, and Sum of Single Effects (SuSiE) fine-mapping assessed genetic sharing and directionality. Results: genetic correlation was substantial (r_g = 0.733). ConjFDR identified 48 shared loci; 36 (75%) showed concordant directions in both phenotype-specific comparisons. Functional annotation implicated axon guidance, oxidative phosphorylation, and developing midbrain cells. ADHD-to-BPD MR was positive (22 instruments; inverse-variance weighted beta = 0.487, SE = 0.082, p = 3.27 x 10^-9), persisting after outlier removal, MR-LAP correction, and exclusion of two instruments at colocalized loci. Reverse MR was positive (five instruments; beta = 0.303, SE = 0.112, p = 6.83 x 10^-3) but heterogeneous and variant-sensitive. CAUSE favored directional over sharing-only models in both directions (delta ELPD = 6.98 and 5.92, respectively). SuSiE colocalization supported shared signals at rs17576773, rs9969232, and rs4727799. Conclusions: ADHD and BPD exhibit extensive genetic overlap involving 48 shared loci and convergent evidence of directional associations. Findings across complementary methods more consistently support an ADHD-to-BPD relationship, suggesting that shared genetic susceptibility alone may not fully explain their co-occurrence.
papers.translated_summary: 背景：注意缺陷多动障碍（ADHD）与边缘型人格障碍（BPD）常共病，但其共享的遗传易感性及方向性关联仍不明确。方法：我们分析了欧洲血统的ADHD（38,691例病例；186,843例对照）和BPD（12,339例病例；1,041,717例对照）全基因组关联研究（GWAS）数据。采用连锁不平衡得分回归、联合错误发现率（conjFDR）、双向孟德尔随机化（MR）、考虑连锁不平衡与样本重叠的MR（MR-LAP）、基于汇总效应估计的因果分析（CAUSE）、共定位分析以及单效应和（SuSiE）精细定位评估遗传共享与方向性。结果：遗传相关性显著（r_g = 0.733）。conjFDR识别出48个共享位点；其中36个（75%）在两种表型特异性比较中显示一致方向。功能注释涉及轴突导向、氧化磷酸化及发育中的中脑细胞。ADHD至BPD的MR为正（22个工具变量；逆方差加权beta = 0.487，SE = 0.082，p = 3.27 x 10^-9），在剔除离群值、MR-LAP校正及排除共定位位点的两个工具变量后仍持续存在。反向MR为正（五个工具变量；beta = 0.303，SE = 0.112，p = 6.83 x 10^-3），但存在异质性且对变异敏感。CAUSE在双向均支持方向性模型优于仅共享模型（delta ELPD分别为6.98和5.92）。SuSiE共定位支持rs17576773、rs9969232和rs4727799处的共享信号。结论：ADHD与BPD表现出广泛的遗传重叠，涉及48个共享位点，并具有方向性关联的汇聚证据。跨互补方法的研究结果更一致地支持ADHD至BPD的关系，提示仅共享遗传易感性可能无法完全解释其共现。

papers.title: Scaled m-BonacciNet: A Recurrence-Guided Lightweight CNN for Efficient Medical Image Classification
papers.translated_title: 缩放m-BonacciNet：一种递归引导的轻量级CNN用于高效医学图像分类
papers.author: Habib, G.
papers.summary: The -Bonacci weighted sequence space {ell}(,) is introduced for [≥] 2, 1 [≤] < {infty}, and > 0). It is proved to be a Banach space which is isometrically isomorphic to {ell}, with an unconditional Schauder basis. The space is also reflexive and uniformly convex. Its strict inclusion chain, continuous dual, and asymptotic truncation estimate of order - / are also established. Based on this framework, Scaled &#119898-BonacciNet is proposed as a lightweight CNN that rescales Fibonacci-Net channels using the dominant &#119898-Bonacci root and employs depth wise separable convolutions. Tribonacci-Net achieved 96.09% accuracy and a 0.9581 macro F1-score on the 15-class Brain MRI dataset using 0.85 million parameters and 0.366 GFLOPs. Pentanacci-Net attained 95.87% accuracy on the 44-class dataset while reducing parameters and FLOPs by 47.10% and 44.48%, respectively. On the CKD ultrasound dataset, Hexanacci-Net achieved 83.75% accuracy and a 0.7941 macro F1-score, with corresponding reductions of 50.37% and 45.10%. These findings support dominant-root scaling as a structured approach to lightweight CNN design.

papers.title: Prospective multi-omic profiling identifies predictive and genetically supported molecular determinants of incident epilepsy
papers.translated_title: 前瞻性多组学分析识别出可预测且具有遗传学支持的癫痫发病分子决定因素
papers.author: Hassanin, E.
papers.summary: Abstract Epilepsy affects approximately 50 million people worldwide, yet biomarkers capable of identifying individuals at risk before clinical onset are lacking, and the molecular mechanisms preceding disease onset remain poorly understood. Here, we integrated plasma proteomic, metabolomic, and genomic data from the UK Biobank to characterize molecular changes preceding epilepsy and evaluate their predictive and causal relevance. We quantified 2,923 plasma proteins in 53,000 participants and followed incident epilepsy for up to 15 years before epilepsy diagnosis. Cox proportional hazards analyses identified 116 proteins associated with incident epilepsy, led by neurofilament light chain (NEFL; HR=2.03) and growth differentiation factor 15 (GDF15; HR=1.73). These proteins were enriched for extracellular signaling, immune regulation, and cell-death pathways and displayed distinct subtype- and age-specific signatures. A proteomic risk score comprising 32 proteins stratified epilepsy risk, with individuals in the highest quintile exhibiting a 3.5-fold greater risk than those in the lowest quintile (AUC=0.70). In parallel, 154 of 249 circulating metabolites were associated with incident epilepsy, with the strongest inverse association observed for citrate (HR=0.72) and positive associations across HDL-related metabolites (HR=1.16-1.21), implicating dysregulated energy and lipoprotein metabolism. A metabolomic risk score showed more modest discrimination (AUC=0.63). Integrating proteomic, metabolomic, polygenic, and demographic information yielded an overall AUC of 0.71 for incident epilepsy; in a separate cross-sectional analysis of individuals with early-onset epilepsy discrimination reached an AUC of 0.79. Proteome-wide cis-pQTL Mendelian randomization identified 12 proteins associated with epilepsy after false discovery rate correction, predominantly for genetic generalized epilepsy. O-GlcNAcase (OGA), a regulator of protein O-GlcNAcylation with established roles in neuronal function and synaptic plasticity, showed the strongest protective association (OR=0.71, FDR=2.7 e-8). Serine protease 53 (PRSS53), a poorly characterized serine protease, showed strong evidence for a potential shared causal variant with epilepsy (colocalization PP.H4=0.95). Together, these findings demonstrate that circulating molecular alterations precede epilepsy diagnosis by years and reveal complementary proteomic, metabolic, and genetic determinants of disease susceptibility, providing a framework for biologically informed risk stratification and therapeutic target prioritization.
papers.translated_summary: 摘要 癫痫影响全球约5000万人，但目前缺乏能够在临床发作前识别高危个体的生物标志物，且对疾病发病前的分子机制了解甚少。本研究整合了英国生物银行的血浆蛋白质组学、代谢组学和基因组学数据，以刻画癫痫发病前的分子变化，并评估其预测价值和因果相关性。我们在53,000名参与者中定量了2,923种血浆蛋白质，并在癫痫诊断前长达15年的随访中追踪了新发癫痫。Cox比例风险分析识别出116种与新发癫痫相关的蛋白质，其中以神经丝轻链（NEFL；HR=2.03）和生长分化因子15（GDF15；HR=1.73）为首。这些蛋白质富集于细胞外信号传导、免疫调节和细胞死亡通路，并呈现出不同的亚型和年龄特异性特征。由32种蛋白质构成的蛋白质组风险评分可对癫痫风险进行分层，最高五分位个体的风险是最低五分位个体的3.5倍（AUC=0.70）。与此同时，249种循环代谢物中有154种与新发癫痫相关，其中柠檬酸盐的反向关联最强（HR=0.72），而HDL相关代谢物呈正向关联（HR=1.16-1.21），提示能量和脂蛋白代谢失调。代谢组风险评分的区分能力较为有限（AUC=0.63）。整合蛋白质组学、代谢组学、多基因和人口学信息后，对新发癫痫的总体AUC为0.71；在针对早发性癫痫个体的另一项横断面分析中，区分能力达到AUC=0.79。蛋白质组范围的顺式-pQTL孟德尔随机化在错误发现率校正后识别出12种与癫痫相关的蛋白质，主要涉及遗传性全面性癫痫。O-GlcNAcase（OGA）是蛋白质O-GlcNAcylation的调节因子，已知在神经元功能和突触可塑性中发挥作用，其保护性关联最强（OR=0.71，FDR=2.7 e-8）。丝氨酸蛋白酶53（PRSS53）是一种特征尚不明确的丝氨酸蛋白酶，显示出与癫痫可能存在共享因果变异的强证据（共定位PP.H4=0.95）。总之，这些发现表明循环分子改变在癫痫诊断前数年即已出现，并揭示了疾病易感性的互补性蛋白质组、代谢和遗传决定因素，为基于生物学信息的风险分层和治疗靶点优先排序提供了框架。

papers.title: Statistical analysis plan for the Preventing InfusAte injuries Throughout a Childs Hospitalisation (PATCH) trial: a type 1 hybrid randomised controlled trial
papers.translated_title: 预防儿童住院期间输液损伤（PATCH）试验的统计分析计划：一项1型混合随机对照试验
papers.author: Takashima, M.
papers.summary: Background: Up to 20% of hospitalised infants with a peripheral intravenous catheter (PIVC) have an infusate-related injury. The PATCH trial is testing whether an IV biosensor (ivWatch) added to standard observation reduces infiltration and extravasation injuries compared with standard observation alone. Methods: PATCH is a multicentre, type 1 hybrid effectiveness-implementation randomised controlled trial at three Queensland hospitals. Infants under 1 year (weighing at least 1000 g) with a PIVC expected to remain more than 24 hours for intermediate- or high-risk infusates, antimicrobials or continuous fluids are randomised 1:1, stratified by site (four strata). The target sample is 532. Analysis: The primary outcome is any infiltration/extravasation injury (mild to severe harm, CCHMC Extravasation Harm Scale), confirmed by a blinded outcome assessment committee. The primary analysis follows intention to treat and uses logistic regression adjusted for randomisation stratum. The risk difference is estimated by standardisation, with the odds ratio also reported. Secondary outcomes include injury severity, time to PIVC failure, dwell time, replacement PIVC, skin injuries and serious adverse events. This plan was finalised on 10/11/2026, during recruitment and before database lock or any unblinded analysis. Trial registration: ACTRN12623000561684.
papers.translated_summary: 背景：高达20%的住院婴儿在使用外周静脉导管（PIVC）时会发生与输注相关的损伤。PATCH试验正在检验在标准观察基础上加用静脉生物传感器（ivWatch）与单独标准观察相比，是否能减少浸润和外渗损伤。方法：PATCH是一项在昆士兰州三家医院开展的多中心、1型混合有效性-实施随机对照试验。年龄小于1岁（体重至少1000 g）、因中等或高风险输注液、抗菌药物或持续液体而预计PIVC留置超过24小时的婴儿，按1:1随机分组，并按研究中心分层（四个层）。目标样本量为532。分析：主要结局是任何浸润/外渗损伤（轻度至重度伤害，CCHMC外渗伤害量表），由盲法结局评估委员会确认。主要分析遵循意向性治疗原则，并使用针对随机分层调整的逻辑回归。风险差通过标准化估计，同时报告比值比。次要结局包括损伤严重程度、PIVC失败时间、留置时间、PIVC更换、皮肤损伤和严重不良事件。该计划于2026年11月10日在招募期间、数据库锁定或任何非盲分析之前最终确定。试验注册：ACTRN12623000561684。

papers.title: Active Health Problems in Real-World Consultations on a Purpose-Built Medical AI Platform
papers.translated_title: 在专门构建的医疗AI平台上，真实世界问诊中的活动性健康问题
papers.author: Adamson, B.
papers.summary: Importance: Consumers use conversational artificial intelligence (AI) for health at scale, but whether purpose-built medical AI is used primarily for information seeking or as an entry point into care remains unclear. Objective: To characterize the clinical concepts users present, their visit intentions, and progression to physician telehealth care in real-world consultations on a purpose-built medical AI platform. Design: Exploratory retrospective cohort study of consultations sampled in equal monthly numbers between June 1, 2025, and June 30, 2026. Setting: A free, publicly available, consumer-facing, anonymous-by-default medical AI platform. Participants: Random sample of 26,000 English-language consultations by users aged 18 years or older, each with at least 5 chat interaction rounds. Exposure: A chat consultation with the medical AI. Main Outcomes and Measures: Clinical concepts linked approximately to SNOMED CT; visit intentions classified with a prespecified 11-category schema and reclassified with a published 12-category consumer-health taxonomy; completion of the AI consult with a structured SOAP note; and progression to a completed physician telehealth visit. Automated extraction pipelines were validated against physician annotation in a random subsample. Results: Of 26,000 sampled consultations, 56.7% were by users recorded as female and 50.9% by users aged 18 to 34 years. Among 25,975 consultations with successful extraction, 77,597 clinical concepts were identified; headache, abdominal pain, fatigue, and fever were the most common presenting concepts. Of 55,257 classified intentions, 60.1% (95% CI, 59.7%-60.5%) concerned a new or worsening condition. When consultations were reclassified with the published consumer-health taxonomy, 74.3% (95% CI, 73.8%-74.8%) included symptom questions or health concerns, whereas 5.0% (95% CI, 4.7%-5.2%) included health information or education, reversing the rank order published for a general-purpose assistant. Overall, 53.9% of sampled consultations ended with a structured SOAP note, and 15.1% of those progressed to a completed physician telehealth review. Conclusions and Relevance: Users of this purpose-built medical AI platform predominantly presented active personal health problems rather than general information requests. Symptom-driven use, generation of structured clinical documentation, and progression to physician care suggest that purpose-built medical AI may function as an entry point to clinical care for some users.
papers.translated_summary: 重要性：消费者大规模使用对话式人工智能（AI）获取健康信息，但专门构建的医疗AI主要用于信息查询还是作为进入医疗服务的入口仍不清楚。目的：描述用户在该专门构建的医疗AI平台真实世界咨询中呈现的临床概念、就诊意图以及向医生远程医疗保健的进展。设计：探索性回顾性队列研究，于2025年6月1日至2026年6月30日期间按月等量抽样咨询。环境：一个免费、公开可用、面向消费者、默认匿名的医疗AI平台。参与者：随机抽取26,000次英语咨询，用户年龄18岁及以上，每次咨询至少有5轮聊天互动。暴露：与医疗AI的聊天咨询。主要结局与测量指标：与SNOMED CT大致关联的临床概念；使用预设的11类方案对就诊意图进行分类，并使用已发表的12类消费者健康分类法重新分类；以结构化SOAP笔记完成AI咨询；以及进展为完成的医生远程医疗就诊。自动化提取流程在随机子样本中对照医生标注进行了验证。结果：在26,000次抽样咨询中，56.7%为记录为女性的用户，50.9%为18至34岁用户。在25,975次成功提取的咨询中，识别出77,597个临床概念；头痛、腹痛、疲劳和发热是最常见的呈现概念。在55,257个分类意图中，60.1%（95% CI，59.7%-60.5%）涉及新发或恶化病情。当使用已发表的消费者健康分类法重新分类咨询时，74.3%（95% CI，73.8%-74.8%）包含症状问题或健康担忧，而5.0%（95% CI，4.7%-5.2%）包含健康信息或教育，这与已发表的通用型助手排名顺序相反。总体而言，53.9%的抽样咨询以结构化SOAP笔记结束，其中15.1%进展为完成的医生远程医疗审查。结论与意义：该专门构建的医疗AI平台的用户主要呈现活跃的个人健康问题，而非一般信息请求。症状驱动的使用、结构化临床文档的生成以及向医生护理的进展表明，专门构建的医疗AI对某些用户可能作为进入临床护理的入口。

papers.title: Manifestation-Guided Adaptation of CT Foundation Model for Early Neurological Prognosis after ECPR
papers.translated_title: ECPR后早期神经预后CT基础模型的manifestation引导适应
papers.author: Kaviany, A.
papers.summary: Purpose. To develop a data-efficient, clinically guided transfer-learning framework for hyperacute neurological outcome prediction from head CT in patients undergoing extracorporeal cardiopulmonary resuscitation (ECPR) after cardiac arrest by leveraging free-text radiology report. Methods. This retrospective study included 683 patients with available CT examination and radiology reports from December 2015 to November 2025. The primary outcome distinguished favorable neurological outcomes (Cerebral Performance Category [CPC] 1-2) from neurological death due to brain death or cerebral herniation (CPC 5). A cross-attention adaptor jointly learned to predict neurological outcome and five report-derived manifestations of brain injury from a frozen pretrained head CT encoder. Outcome prediction used CT images alone at inference. The manifestation-guided adaptor, trained with and without additional patients who contributed only manifestation labels, was compared with outcome-only adaptor and two pooled-feature baselines. Performance was summarized as mean {+/-} SD across five held-out folds. Results. Of 683 patients, 197 were eligible for outcome evaluation (63 with favorable outcomes and 134 with neurological death), and 486 formed the manifestation-only cohort. The area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) was 0.918 {+/-} 0.044 for the outcome-only adaptor. The manifestation-guided adaptor achieved an AUROC of 0.927 {+/-} 0.042. With additional manifestation-only training data, the adaptor achieved the mean AUROC (0.929 {+/-} 0.037), specificity (93.7% {+/-} 6.5%), with a sensitivity of 79.9% {+/-} 9.2%. Conclusion. Manifestation-guided adaptation outperforms outcome-only adaptation for neurological outcome prediction from hyperacute head CT after ECPR. Report-derived manifestation labels enabled training with additional examinations without eligible outcome labels while preserving CT-only prediction.
papers.translated_summary: 目的。利用自由文本放射学报告，开发一个数据高效、临床指导的迁移学习框架，用于在接受体外心肺复苏（ECPR）的心脏骤停患者中，基于头部CT进行超急性期神经功能结局预测。方法。本回顾性研究纳入2015年12月至2025年11月期间具有可用CT检查和放射学报告的683例患者。主要结局区分有利神经功能结局（脑功能表现分类[CPC]1-2）与因脑死亡或脑疝导致的神经性死亡（CPC 5）。交叉注意力适配器从冻结的预训练头部CT编码器中联合学习预测神经功能结局和五项报告衍生的脑损伤表现。结局预测在推理时仅使用CT图像。表现引导适配器分别在有无仅贡献表现标签的额外患者参与下进行训练，并与仅结局适配器和两个池化特征基线进行比较。性能以五个留出折的均值{+/-}标准差汇总。结果。在683例患者中，197例符合结局评估条件（63例结局有利，134例神经性死亡），486例构成仅表现队列。仅结局适配器的受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUROC）为0.918{+/-}0.044。表现引导适配器达到AUROC 0.927{+/-}0.042。在加入仅表现训练数据后，适配器达到平均AUROC（0.929{+/-}0.037）、特异度（93.7%{+/-}6.5%），敏感度为79.9%{+/-}9.2%。结论。对于ECPR后超急性期头部CT的神经功能结局预测，表现引导适配优于仅结局适配。报告衍生的表现标签使得能够利用无合格结局标签的额外检查进行训练，同时保留仅CT预测。
